races.paceDynamic: Runman will take the field along from the front with no genuine pace pressure, creating a sustainable gallop that should build gradually through the middle sections. The prominent runners Adamlyi, Revelio and Carly Minogue will track close behind but none possess the natural gate speed to challenge Runman's supremacy early. This sets up a tactical affair where the hold-up horses Atlas Mountain, Moreedd, Mr Bollinger and Florizelle can be delivered late into what should be a moderate tempo. The combination of one uncontested leader and several closers positioned to strike favours horses that can finish strongly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Runman gets his own way in front with soft fractions
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the field to reel him back in, allowing his superior class (OR 90, two from two) to tell over the final furlong. His proven stamina at this trip on good ground makes him extremely difficult to pass when not under early pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows hold-up horses perfect positioning turning for home
scenarios.body: Atlas Mountain or Moreedd can unleash their finishing kicks from ideal spots as the field concertinas over the final two furlongs. The gelding operation on Atlas Mountain may have sharpened him significantly since his keeping-on Newbury effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Adamlyi or a debut runner can quicken past a tiring Runman
scenarios.body: The Haggas second string shows the benefit of his Yarmouth near-miss or one of the well-bred newcomers produces a professional display. Adamlyi's stamina-laden pedigree suits this sustained test after looking in need of the trip previously.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo becomes crawling and produces a blanket finish
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can strike, potentially elevating an outsider like the freshened Mr Bollinger. The drop back to 1m4f from 1m2f efforts could unlock improvement for several runners.

watchPoints.text: Runman could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions, his 1-12 Epsom victory shows class edge when getting own way
Peace And Quiet and other debutants represent unknown quantities with strong breeding - market support crucial indicator
Atlas Mountain showed promise keeping on at Newbury before gelding operation - watch for sharper display
The 336-day absence makes Carly Minogue and any other returning horses fitness concerns
Track Adamlyi for tactical positioning - his Yarmouth second suggests he needs prominent pitch to be effective

races.paceDynamic: Knights Charge will set a steady gallop from the front with minimal pressure, having shown clear leading tendencies in his AW wins. Outflank and Domenico Contarini will likely track him in the early stages, but neither appears keen to apply serious pressure given their prominent rather than aggressive styles. The pace will be genuine but not taxing through the middle sections, setting up a tactical finish over the final 2-3 furlongs. This measured tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, as the leaders will have plenty left for the closing stages without being softened up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Knights Charge sets his expected steady tempo without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows closers to position perfectly and unleash their kicks when it matters most. Bay Royale, Liam Mera Kai and Cliff Danger can all benefit from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners hold on
scenarios.trigger: If the closing kick from behind fails to materialise due to traffic or positioning
scenarios.body: Knights Charge maintains his rhythm throughout and Outflank's prominent position pays dividends. The steady pace means the leaders retain enough stamina to resist late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomers spring surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Cloud Forest or Zurna show significant improvement from their breeding and connections
scenarios.body: The Godolphin runner or Sea The Moon half-brother produces an unexpectedly strong debut performance. Their fresh legs and potential class could overcome the established form horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Knights Charge goes very slowly and the field bunches up dangerously
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where positioning and luck become crucial factors. The race turns into a lottery where any horse getting a clear run can prevail regardless of ability.

watchPoints.text: Knights Charge if he goes too fast early - could compromise his stamina reserves for the finish
Cloud Forest market support given Godolphin's strike rate with well-bred newcomers under Murphy
Bay Royale's positioning in the early stages as he needs to be handy enough to deliver his kick
Late money for Zurna despite trainer's poor newcomer record - breeding could override statistics
Outflank's jump from the stalls as prominent position crucial if pace becomes truly stop-start

races.paceDynamic: Stepanov is the lone confirmed front-runner and will take them along at a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Sports Day and Grindleton as prominent runners may track closely but are unlikely to challenge for the lead early. The lack of genuine pace-pressers means Stepanov can dictate terms through steady fractions before the field fans out in the straight. This setup clearly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid gallop and finish strongly, while prominent runners may find themselves positioned awkwardly behind the uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Stepanov sets modest fractions uncontested through the first three-quarters
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks from off the pace. Multiple closers can take advantage as the leaders tire after the sustained effort over 1m2f.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Stepanov Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner's sustainable pace proves too much for the closer brigade
scenarios.body: Stepanov capitalizes on his uncontested lead and soft fractions to maintain his advantage to the line. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to reserve enough energy for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Sports Day or Grindleton can position perfectly behind Stepanov and time their move
scenarios.body: The prominent runners benefit from tracking the leader's honest pace before striking in the final two furlongs. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the field as Stepanov begins to tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Drama
scenarios.trigger: If Stepanov goes too slowly and creates a messy sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace leads to a bunched field and tactical chaos in the straight. Jockey skills become paramount as multiple horses arrive together in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Stepanov could get away with very soft fractions if no prominent runners apply early pressure

Premier Cru and Veld both making turf debuts with hold-up styles perfectly suited to expected pace shape

races.paceDynamic: Island Bear will likely lead uncontested with the field small enough to avoid early pace pressure. Rosa Inglesa, Beyond The Bar, North Force and I'm Just Ken will all converge in the prominent positions creating a wall of traffic 2-3 furlongs out. With only Chapter sitting back as a genuine hold-up horse, the pace will be honest but sustainable through the middle stages. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can secure clear racing room early, as the lone leader Island Bear may find it hard to sustain his effort when the pack arrives.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade gets clean splits turning in
scenarios.body: The honest pace sets up perfectly for horses like North Force and Rosa Inglesa who can track the leader without getting caught in traffic. Their superior recent form tells when getting uninterrupted runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Longest
scenarios.trigger: If Island Bear maintains his kick when challenged in the straight
scenarios.body: The gelding operation and return to turf could unlock improvement, and with no early pace pressure he gets soft fractions to work with. His previous placed efforts on good going give him every chance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Chapter handles the going despite ground concerns
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace and bunched prominent pack creates the perfect scenario for the only genuine closer to sweep up late. His previous form on heavy suggests he may need cut but could surprise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improver From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If Domination's Ripon win was a breakthrough moment rather than a fluke
scenarios.body: The step up two grades is significant but the form horse gets racing room from his mid-division position. His recent success suggests untapped potential at this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Stella Lucente and Ziata will ensure a strong early gallop as both confirmed front-runners clash from the gates. With 13 runners over 1m4f, the pace should be honest but not suicidal, allowing the field to stay reasonably compact through the middle stages. The final 3f will see the pace intensify as prominent racers and hold-up horses launch their challenges. This honest pace scenario clearly favours horses with proven finishing kicks who can sit handy or further back, making hold-up and midfield runners the tactical beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest but not excessive between the two leaders
scenarios.body: The pace will set up perfectly for closers like Wondrous Light and Jamie Sommers who can use their proven finishing speed. Saliko's course record (2-2 at Nottingham) becomes crucial as the race develops into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders goes too fast and the other gets pulled along
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will suit horses like Huggable and Pretty Spirited who can track the pace without getting involved early. Their proven ability to quicken off a solid pace gives them the edge over tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survival
scenarios.trigger: If both Stella Lucente and Ziata settle better than expected and share the work
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more manageable, allowing one of them to have enough left for the finish. Stella Lucente's consistent placed form makes her the more likely survivor with Oisin Murphy's tactical nous.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go off too fast and tie each other up completely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole with no clear pace advantage. This random finish could suit an outsider like Pretty Spirited who has been running well lately or Katalyst if the headgear works.

races.paceDynamic: Dunnington Lad will lead from stall rise but faces no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a steady pace through the initial stages. Six prominent runners (Bang On The Bell, Irish Dancer, Timebar, Nad Alshiba Snow, Charging Bull, Barmyblade, Poetic Jack) will create congestion 2-3 furlongs out as they fan wide seeking racing room. The hold-up brigade including Sonic Si, Masterclass and Chasing Gold will face a wall of horses ahead turning for home. This sustainable early pace followed by prominent congestion strongly favours those who can secure an early position and avoid traffic - the pace shape benefits front-runners and those tracking the leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dunnington Lad maintains his early advantage without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows him to conserve energy while prominent runners get tangled up behind, giving the leader first run on the field. His front-running style perfectly exploits the lack of early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners engage in sustained scrimmaging from 3f out
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly as they jostle for position, creating gaps for patient hold-up horses to exploit late. Superior class tells as the field stretches out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion completely stalls turning for home
scenarios.body: Patient runners get clear passage down the outside while the leaders and prominent pack tie up badly. Late acceleration becomes the winning weapon despite the early steady tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Dunnington Lad sets funeral fractions and prominent runners refuse to engage
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete crawl until the final 2f when everything comes with one devastating late run. The winner emerges from complete obscurity in the final 100 yards.
